description: The line plot illustrates the number of shared experts for two samples across varying sample token counts for six different categories: Intent, Summary, Law, Translation, Code, and Math. The x-axis represents the Sample Token Count on a logarithmic scale (base 2), ranging from $2^9$ to $2^{20}$ with tick marks at every power of 2. The y-axis represents the Shared Experts for Two Samples on a linear scale, ranging from 2.0 to 6.0 with tick marks at intervals of 0.5. All data is represented by solid lines without markers. The solid coral line representing Intent begins at approximately 3.8 at $2^9$, rises to 4.3 at $2^{10}$, dips to 3.9 at $2^{11}$, rises sharply to 5.2 at $2^{12}$, and generally trends upward to finish at 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The solid blue line for Summary starts at approximately 1.9 at $2^9$, climbs steeply to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, dips slightly to 4.5 at $2^{12}$, and then steadily increases to reach 5.9 at $2^{20}$. The solid gold line representing Law starts at 3.6 at $2^9$, peaks early at 5.1 at $2^{11}$, drops to 4.6 at $2^{12}$, rises to another peak of 5.8 at $2^{14}$, dips to 5.5 at $2^{15}$, and concludes at 6.0 at $2^{20}$. The solid purple line for Translation begins at 5.1 at $2^9$, rises to 5.3 at $2^{10}$, drops to 4.7 at $2^{11}$, and then climbs steadily to plateau near 5.9 from $2^{17}$ to $2^{20}$. The solid grey line representing Code starts at 1.9 at $2^9$, remains relatively flat until $2^{10}$, rises to 3.7 at $2^{13}$, experiences a sharp decline to 3.1 at $2^{14}$, and then exhibits a steep upward trend to end at 5.8 at $2^{20}$. Finally, the solid green line for Math begins at 3.8 at $2^9$ and demonstrates a relatively steady, continuous upward trend throughout the x-axis, reaching 5.9 at $2^{18}$, dipping slightly to 5.8 at $2^{19}$, and ending at 5.9 at $2^{20}$.
